o.text: Calque of Russian наркоторго́вец (narkotorgóvec). Can be seen as a partial phono-semantic matching from Russian term.
Per Bəşirov, comes from earlier *toza- + -anaq. Alternatively, it may be derived from Proto-Turkic *tōzan (“dust”) + -aq.
From Russian и́мидж (ímidž), from English image.
